blocks.text: (Satellite image from Pagasa) MANILA, Philippines — The northeasterly wind flow and the easterlies, or warm winds from the Pacific Ocean, may affect most of the country on Wednesday, Oct. 14, the state weather bureau said. In its 4 p.m. weather advisory, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) reported that the northeasterly wind flow may bring partly cloudy to cloudy skies with isolated rains to the Ilocos Region, Cordillera Administrative Region, Batanes, Cagayan, and Isabela. Meanwhile, Pagasa also reported that the Bicol Region, Western Visayas, Eastern Visayas, Quezon, Oriental Mindoro, Occidental Mindoro, Marinduque, and Romblon may experience cloudy […]...
